messages:
Anya: Heads-up — want a quick sync on the onramp + add-on thresholds we're baking into the Q2 pricing rollout. Need to lock launch criteria by EOD Friday so PMM and sales can prep collateral.
Mike: Quick context — infra needs clear concurrency and burst rules for Dedicated reservations. Otherwise we can't guarantee the latency SLOs customers expect.
Raj: +1. From infra side we need: max_concurrency per tenant, soft_burst tokens, and fallback model mapping. Current defaults are small and will cause throttles.
Sofia: From product POV here's the proposed minimums:
- Free tier: 5k tokens/mo, embeddings disabled
- Starter: 100k tokens/mo, 5 rps, basic embeddings
- Business: 2M tokens/mo, 50 rps, embeddings + rerank add-on
- Enterprise: custom commit, reserved throughput
Anya: @Sofia can you quickly confirm which add-ons are mandatory vs optional for Business? Sales needs deterministic bundle contents.
Sofia: Mandatory for Business = embeddings (basic). Optional = reranking, priority-support. We should require a minimum requests-per-second target for Business to avoid noisy tenants.
Kayla: Sales note — we need clear guardrails for trial-to-paid conversion. Trials often try enterprise features and then expect them in Starter. Suggest: trials get rerank as a timeboxed add-on only.
Ben: Legal/contract constraint: for committed Enterprise we must include a clause that prevents silent auto-upgrades of reserved capacity without explicit customer approval. Also need cap on early termination credits.
pricing-bot: Reminder: there's an open PR that enforces per-tenant rate limits in the billing service — #pr-4983. Failing to merge blocks billing telemetry for new SKUs.
Anya: Operational launch checklist (draft):
1) Finalize SKUs + add-on descriptions (Sofia)
2) Merge billing PR + env flag (Mike)
3) Create sales cheat sheet + trial policy (Kayla)
4) Legal to draft contract clause for reserved capacity (Ben)
5) QA load test against Starter and Business profiles (Raj)
6) Docs + pricing page copy (PMM)
Sofia: Launch criteria proposal (must all be true):
- Billing PR merged and feature-flagged
- Billing telemetry reports token usage by SKU during 72h internal pilot
- Latency p95 < 350ms for Starter profile under expected load
- Sales + PMM signoff on add-on language
Anya: For numbers on burst and concurrency Raj — can you drop the configs you need? A sample snippet would help Mike implement quickly.
Raj: Sample snippet (config YAML):
```
tenant_limits:
  starter:
    max_concurrency: 5
    soft_burst_tokens: 200
    fallback_model: gpt-lite-v1
  business:
    max_concurrency: 50
    soft_burst_tokens: 2000
    fallback_model: gpt-medium-v1
```
Mike: That works; I'll wire those into rate-limiter + autoscaler. Two questions: what happens when soft_burst_tokens exhausted — immediate 429 or queueing?
Sofia: Prefer graceful degradation: queue up to 2s, then 429. We want UX predictability for customer apps.
Kayla: Also add a note for SKUs: marketing wants "Starter includes lightweight embeddings" phrasing — legal to confirm accuracy.
Ben: I'll draft the reserved-capacity contract paragraph and share by tomorrow.
Anya: Risk check: top risks before launch?
Mike: If billing telemetry isn't granular, we might under/overcharge during pilot.
Raj: Load test variance — we need to run at different seq lengths; token consumption can vary 3x.
Kayla: Sales enablement timeline is tight — need final SKUs by Friday to hit training next week.
Sofia: Contingency: if telemetry isn't ready, we can soft-launch to paid-only customers with manual reconciliation for 30 days.
Anya: OK — action owners noted. I'll follow up with a 1-pager for execs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Ben: Thanks — looping in legal channel after I finish draft.
pricing-bot: Noted: triggering billing PR monitor. CI pipeline will post status updates in #eng-releases.
